title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: ACTION: Answer the small Marvelous box, then leave Marvelous open
why: The export of every Marvelous project to open files waits on it.
Every garment is already saved on F:, so nothing is lost.
steps: Look at Marvelous Designer on the PC
Answer or close the small box in front of it (a sign-in box: sign in; anything else: OK or Close)
Leave Marvelous open, then tap Done below
sections.tried: The bridge's starter (13:43) found one copy, as wanted, but a small box of its own sits over the main window, so it stops by design; a scheduled run has no computer use, and Claude clicks nothing in a box it cannot read.
sections.recommendation: Do it today when you are at the PC: about one minute.
